description: This pie chart visually represents the distribution of emotional states across a dataset, likely from speech recordings, with six distinct categories: Frustration, Neutral, Anger, Sadness, Happiness, and Excitement. The chart is divided into six colored slices, each labeled with its corresponding emotion and percentage. The largest segment is Frustration at 25.1%, followed by Neutral at 23.1%, then Happiness and Excitement tied at 14.1%, Anger at 14.9%, and Sadness at 14.7%. The segments are arranged in a clockwise order starting from the top left, with Frustration being the largest slice. The chart includes a legend implicitly through the labels and colors, and each slice has its percentage value printed directly inside it. There are no exploded slices or visual emphasis beyond the standard pie chart presentation.
